This is a list of terms and their meaning in the context of PostgreSQL.

ACID

Atomicity, Consistency, Isolation, and Durability.

Analyze (operation)

The act of collecting statistics from data in tables.

For more information, see ANALYZE.

Database server

See Instance.

Input/Output (I/O)

Input/Output (I/O) describes the communication between a program and peripheral devices.

Instance

A group of backend and auxiliary processes that communicate using a common shared memory area.

Standby (server)

See Replica (server).

Replica (server)

A database that is paired with a primary database.

Not in the glosslist
